title: 第25章 苏仙媚第26章 四宗长老
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
“我的天！”
“这林白怎么杀了这么多妖兽！”
“一只，两只，五只……九十只，一百五十只！”
“居然有整整一百五十只。”
“而且这些妖兽，全部都是武道四重到武道八重之间的妖兽！”
“这废物林白，什么时候变得这么厉害吗？”
“奇怪，他不是一个废物嘛？”
林白取出这么多的妖兽尸体，吓得周围人一跳。
这么多妖兽，别说是杀了，他们连见都没有见过。
“这，这，这……”艾琳美丽的眸光也被吓得久久难以回神。
叶如龙宛如见了鬼一样的盯着堆积如山的妖兽尸骨，说道：“这不可能，这不可能，你怎么可能击杀武道八重的妖兽，你是一个废物呀，你是一个废物呀。”
“你别管我这些妖兽是怎么杀的，反正这些妖兽在这里了。”林白说道。
“艾琳，给个价格吧。”
林白淡然一笑。
“这么多的妖兽，我还需要去找几个姐妹来帮帮忙，数清楚后，才能给你报价。”艾琳说道。
“好，你去吧。”林白点头道。
的确这么多的妖兽，光靠艾琳一个人，是不可能数的过来的。
“不用了，一共一百五十头妖兽，我藏宝楼以三千灵石收了。”
正当艾琳要去找人帮忙的时候，而藏宝楼的二楼上，走下来一个宛如仙女的女子。
这女子，一声红色旗袍，双唇似血，美眸狭长，肌肤凝脂雪白，双目勾魂索魄，胸前一对鼓起的豪乳，盈盈一握的腰肢下是圆润饱满的臀部。

一双完美无瑕的玉腿在裙摆下若隐若现。
当这个美丽的女子一出现的时候，所有人的脑海中冒出四个字来：天生尤物！
“三千，就三千，公子觉得如何？”这旗袍美人走林白面前，一口扑鼻的幽香传入林白的口鼻中。
这些妖兽虽然很多，但是林白知道，这绝对不价值三千。
为何这个旗袍美人一出来，就直接开了一个天价收购呢？
林白还没有回答，叶如龙便怒吼道：“你算什么混账东西，敢来乱报价，这些东西值得了三千灵石嘛。”
“哼哼，在本公子面前胡闹，我告诉你，你今天闯大祸了。我可是叶家的大少爷、”
“你若是不想得罪我，今晚上就乖乖洗干净，爬到本少爷的床上去，把本少爷服侍舒服了，兴趣还能饶你一命。”叶如龙对这旗袍美人说道。
听见叶如龙这句话，林白心中暗骂白痴。
这女子能从二楼上走下来，身份绝对不一般，叶如龙这个精虫上脑的白痴，居然敢去挑衅她，这不是找死嘛！
艾琳一听，当即怒喝道：“你才混账，这位是我们藏宝楼的分店店主，苏仙媚，藏宝楼的十八位长老之一！”
“叶如龙，你敢如此说话，别说是你，你整个叶家都活不了。”
艾琳怒斥道。
虽然艾琳一声怒斥，将叶如龙的精虫吓了回去，惊慌失措的急忙跪下求饶：“苏阁主饶命，苏阁主饶命，是我胡言乱语，是我有眼无珠，还请苏阁主赎罪。”
苏仙媚红唇含笑，淡淡的撇了一眼叶如龙后，失去了兴趣。
“小弟弟，怎么样，三千灵石如何？”苏仙媚又对林白笑着问道。
“那好吧，就三千吧。”林白应了下来。
艾琳瞪了一眼跪着的叶如龙道：“还不快滚。”
“是是是，我这就滚，这就滚。”叶如龙如蒙大赦的说道。
“等会，你还没有磕头呢。”林白咧嘴笑道。

“现在我拿出来三千灵石了，叶如龙，你是不是该给我磕头呢？”
林白盯着叶如龙说道。
content_en:
"Oh my God!"
"Why did Lin Bai kill so many monsters?"
"One, two, five... ninety, one hundred and fifty!"
"There are actually a hundred and fifty of them."
"And these monsters are all between the fourth level and the eighth level of martial arts!"
"When did this good-for-nothing Lin Bai become so powerful?"
"Strange, isn't he a waste?"
Lin Bai took out so many monster beast corpses that the people around him were shocked.
They have never even seen so many monsters, let alone killed them.
"This, this, this..." Irene's beautiful eyes were also frightened and could not recover for a long time.
Ye Rulong stared at the mountains of monster corpses as if he had seen a ghost, and said: "This is impossible, this is impossible, how can you kill the monsters at the eighth level of martial arts? You are a waste, you are a waste."
"Don't worry about how I killed these monsters. Anyway, these monsters are here." Lin Bai said.
"Erin, give me a price."
Lin Bai smiled lightly.
"With so many monsters, I still need to find a few sisters to help. Only after counting them clearly can I give you a quote." Eileen said.
"Okay, go ahead." Lin Bai nodded.
Indeed, there were so many monsters that it was impossible for Irene alone to count them.
"No need, there are a total of one hundred and fifty monsters, and my treasure house collected them with three thousand spirit stones."
Just when Irene was about to find someone for help, a woman who looked like a fairy came down from the second floor of the treasure building.
This woman wears a red cheongsam, her lips are like blood, her beautiful eyes are long and narrow, her skin is creamy white, her eyes are seductive, she has a pair of swollen breasts on her chest, and her waist is round and plump buttocks.
A pair of flawless jade legs are looming under the skirt.
When this beautiful woman appeared, four words came to everyone's mind: a natural beauty!
"Three thousand, just three thousand, what do you think, young master?" This beauty in cheongsam walked in front of Lin Bai, and a fragrant fragrance spread into Lin Bai's mouth and nose.
Although there were many of these monsters, Lin Bai knew that they were definitely not worth three thousand.
Why did she immediately buy this cheongsam beauty at a sky-high price as soon as it came out?
Before Lin Bai could answer, Ye Rulong roared angrily: "What kind of bastard are you? You dare to make random quotes? These things are worth three thousand spirit stones."
"Hmph, you are messing around in front of me. I tell you, you are in big trouble today. I am the eldest young master of the Ye family."
"If you don't want to offend me, just wash yourself off tonight, crawl into my young master's bed, and make me feel comfortable serving you. If you are interested, you may be spared your life." Ye Rulong said to the cheongsam beauty.
Hearing Ye Rulong's words, Lin Bai secretly cursed an idiot in his heart.
This woman was able to walk down from the second floor, and her status was absolutely extraordinary. Ye Rulong, an idiot with a spermatozoa, actually dared to provoke her. Isn't this looking for death?
When Irene heard this, she immediately shouted angrily: "You're the bastard, this is the branch owner of our treasure house, Su Xianmei, one of the eighteen elders of the treasure house!"
"Ye Rulong, you dare to speak like this, let alone you, your entire Ye family will not survive."
Erin snapped.
Although Irene scolded Ye Rulong's sperm back, she panicked and hurriedly knelt down and begged for mercy: "Pavilion Master Su, have mercy on me, Pavilion Master Su, have mercy on me, it was me who was talking nonsense and I was blind, please atone for my sins, Master Su."
Su Xianmei smiled with red lips, glanced at Ye Rulong lightly, and then lost interest.
"Little brother, how are you doing? How about three thousand spirit stones?" Su Xianmei asked Lin Bai with a smile.
"Okay then, just three thousand." Lin Bai agreed.
Irene glared at Ye Rulong who was kneeling and said, "Get out of here."
"Yes, yes, I'm going to get out of here, I'm going to get out of here right now." Ye Rulong said in a tone of amnesty.
"Wait a minute, you haven't kowtowed yet." Lin Bai grinned..
"Now that I have taken out three thousand spirit stones, Ye Rulong, should you kowtow to me?"
Lin Bai stared at Ye Rulong and said.
